prompts.name: 人物库-IP定位-清爽排版-v3
prompts.prompt: Edit the attached Chinese mini-program UI review board. Preserve the business scope and warm ivory/white/brown identity, but comprehensively CLEAN THE COPY AND REBALANCE SCALE. Output one landscape board showing FOUR evenly sized 390x844 mobile screens side by side, no giant board title, no numbered pills, no subtitles or footer disclaimers. Only small plain captions UNDER the four phones: “人物库”“新增人物”“补充定位”“人物详情”. The image is a design mockup, not a live screenshot. Inside UI delete ALL instructional prose, example prefixes, “（示例）” labels, duplicated headings, status-explanation paragraphs, excessive notes, large decorative filler and generic helper copy. Do NOT delete actual profile data, actionable labels or essential controls. Use consistent 16px horizontal page margins, 16px card padding, 12px card corner radius, 16–20px vertical section gaps, 44–48px input/picker rows, 48px buttons, label type 13–14px, actual field text 15px, native page title 18px, thin neutral borders. Flat rich warm brown #824019 primary buttons, no gradients, no oversized avatar or giant text. Native WeChat header with left back arrow and right capsule remains, ivory page background #faf8f4 and white cards. Make the content naturally readable and correctly proportioned, no crowding or overlaps. Align fixed action bars above safe bottom insets. First phone “人物库”: a search row “搜索人物” with compact adjacent outlined “＋新增”; two modest side by side tool entry cards, line icons and ONLY “口播分身”“语音克隆”; a single compact person card with 40px generic outline avatar, name “张工”, subtitle “乡墅设计师”, concise service line “自建房方案 · 户型优化 · 预算梳理”; a small subtle “IP已完善” status and an arrow/link “查看定位”. No other notes, no uncreated/uncopied badge clutter, no massive full width add button. Main content starts just below nav with coherent spacing rather than random large blank gaps. Second phone native title “新增人物”, DO NOT add a second IP定位 title or a fake one-tab bar. One coherent full-width form in a white card, labels above inputs: “姓名” with value 张工; “身份” value 乡墅设计师; “服务范围” value 自建房方案、户型优化、预算梳理 (textarea roughly 72px); “目标人群” value 准备建房的农村家庭; “表达特点” 3 restrained selectable chips 专业 / 通俗 / 不过度承诺. Below form a simple collapsed row “补充定位” and chevron; bottom primary “保存定位”. No red stars on every label. Third phone title “补充定位”, no repeated section heading or green 选填 badge. Four equally spaced sensible textareas with short labels and short populated data: “客户关注” => 预算、布局、施工; “真实资料” => 已核实的项目与服务资料; “代表口播” => 先把预算和居住需求理清楚。; “禁用表达” => 最低价、固定工期保证. Consistent textarea height ~88px, enough visual separation. Bottom primary “保存”. No example prefixes or further description. Fourth phone native title “人物详情”, small 40px avatar and 张工 / 乡墅设计师 row; compact three-way tabs “IP定位”“口播分身”“语音克隆”, first selected with thin brown underline. White structured data card, short labels and actual saved values for 身份/服务范围/目标人群/表达特点, wrapped cleanly; no big “人物简介” heading and no narrative paragraph. Balanced bottom actions outlined “编辑定位” and primary “用于二创”. No explanatory footer text. Every string must be clear Simplified Chinese. Keep screen layouts aligned and scale consistent across all four phones.

prompts.name: 人物库-分身声音-清爽排版-v3
prompts.prompt: Edit the attached FOUR-phone Chinese WeChat mini-program board into a clean, rationally scaled V3. Preserve four flows: 口播分身 / 语音克隆 / 人物资源 / 数字人口播. Preserve ivory white warm brown style, but DELETE all surplus explanation and redundant content. One landscape board, FOUR equally sized 390x844 phone screens side by side, NO giant heading, NO numbered pills, NO outside footer notes, ONLY tiny plain captions under phones matching their page names. These are UI design proposals, no live completion claim. Native WeChat header remains, consistent 18px title. Shared geometry: page padding16px, card padding16px, section gaps16–20px, card radius12px, 44–48px input/picker rows, 48px buttons, clean 15px body text, 13px labels, 24px line icons. Use flat #824019 primary buttons, #faf8f4 backgrounds, white cards, neutral hairline borders, no gradients, no oversized text or avatars, no crowded wraps. Buttons fixed with proper bottom safe area and same vertical baseline. REMOVE all “（示例）” suffixes, repeating person-header blocks, repeated big upload labels, duplicate instructional paragraphs, “以实时报价为准” helper text, unnecessary decorations. Keep essential file requirements, authorization and credit amount row because they affect user action. PHONE1 title “口播分身”. Begin directly with a compact white form card, one picker row 所属人物 / 张工 (no large avatar/name header duplicating selection); field 资源名称 value 张工分身; a modest upload zone around 140–160px high with one small video outline icon and text “上传视频”; BELOW tiny single line “MP4 · ≤50MB”; a checkbox row “本人素材或已授权”; compact aligned fee row “制作积分” on left and “—” on right, no invented numeric price. Single bottom primary “确认制作”. Natural even spacing, no exaggerated blank space between controls. PHONE2 title “语音克隆”. Same exact structure and alignment: 所属人物 张工; 资源名称 张工声音; upload zone small waveform icon and “上传音频”; tiny requirement “MP3 · ≤20MB · 5秒–3分钟”; same authorization row; 制作积分 —; bottom primary “确认克隆”. Do not duplicate name header or add any prose. PHONE3 title “人物资源”. One compact context row 所属人物 张工. Two tidy resource cards or rows with small icon, title “张工分身” with subtle status “已就绪”, and “张工声音” status “已就绪” plus a small “试听” outlined icon button. No third unrelated 制作中 row, no 示例 tags and no repeated descriptive subtitles. A compact text action with refresh icon “刷新” near top right of list; bottom primary “用于口播”. Resource rows ~96px each, deliberate natural empty space rather than stretched giant controls. PHONE4 title “数字人口播”. Compact white selection group with three aligned picker rows “人物” 张工, “分身” 张工分身, “声音” 张工声音 with small 试听 icon. White script card label “口播文案”, textarea around 180–200px high, containing only “准备建房，先理清预算和居住需求。” No explanation. Bottom two aligned actions outline “查看任务” width roughly 36%, primary “生成口播” width 60%, 12px gap. No full width double stacked giant buttons. Make the product feel quiet, clean, practical and consistent. Readable precise Simplified Chinese throughout.
